# vaultwarden_user (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a user of the Vaultwarden server by ID or email, including invited users. The time the user was last active is only available from the `vaultwarden_users` data source.

Requires `admin_token` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a user by email
data "vaultwarden_user" "by_email" {
  email = "user@example.com"
}

# Or by ID
data "vaultwarden_user" "by_id" {
  id = "5b7c2f2e-3c4e-4a39-9a51-2f0c4c7d8e91"
}

output "user_has_two_factor" {
  value = data.vaultwarden_user.by_email.two_factor_enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) The email of the user to look up, compared case-insensitively. Exactly one of `id` and `email` must be set
- `id` (String) The ID of the user to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `email` must be set

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the user was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the user has verified their email. Always `true` when the server has no SMTP configured
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled. A disabled user cannot log in
- `invited` (Boolean) Whether the user was invited and has not created an account (set a master password) yet
- `name` (String) The name of the user, `null` when empty. Vaultwarden sets the name of an invited user to their email
- `organizations` (Attributes List) The organizations the user is a confirmed member of, sorted by name. Organizations the user is only invited to, or has accepted but is not yet confirmed in, are not listed (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))
- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user has two-step login enabled

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization
- `name` (String) The name of the organization
- `organization_user_id` (String) The ID of the user's membership in the organization
- `type` (String) The type of the user in the organization: `Owner`, `Admin`, `User` or `Manager`
